note: Assessment criteria summary — written in own words from the published unit specification. The live assignment task wording is distributed in class by your teacher.

tasks.title: Research and planning for the client brief

criteria.text: Undertake research showing adequate understanding of how website development principles are used to meet a specific purpose, using partially relevant examples.
Produce a site map that partially meets the client's requirements.
Undertake research showing good understanding of how the principles are used, with mostly relevant examples.
Produce a site map that mostly meets the client's requirements.
Carry out effective research demonstrating a thorough understanding of the principles and how to comprehensively meet the client's requirements, using pertinent examples.

tasks.title: Designs and assets for the client brief

criteria.text: Produce adequate wireframes and visual designs for a specific purpose.
Use asset management techniques to develop assets that partially meet the client's requirements.
Produce mostly effective wireframes and visual designs for a specific purpose.
Use asset management techniques to develop assets that meet most of the client's requirements.
Make effective use of website design skills to develop designs and assets that comprehensively meet the client's requirements.

tasks.title: Build, test and review the website

criteria.text: Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a website that partially meets the client's requirements.
Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a website that meets most of the client's requirements.
Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a website that comprehensively meets the client's requirements.

task1.Pass: Adequate research with partially relevant examples; a site map that meets some of the client's requirements; response may lack coherent structure.
task1.Merit: Good research with mostly relevant examples; explanation of impact on the user; an annotated site map meeting most requirements; appropriate structure and some technical vocabulary.
task1.Distinction: Effective, accomplished research with pertinent examples; thorough understanding and analysis of positive and negative outcomes; detailed site map clearly annotated to show how it meets all client requirements; well-structured with accurate technical vocabulary.

task2.Pass: Basic use of wireframing tools to produce adequate wireframes; straightforward visual designs showing partial understanding; some assets with some audience appeal meeting key requirements.
task2.Merit: Good use of wireframing tools producing mostly effective wireframes; appropriate designs showing good understanding; assets with appropriate appeal meeting most requirements.
task2.Distinction: Accomplished use of wireframing tools producing effective wireframes; effective designs demonstrating thorough understanding of client requirements and user needs; effective asset management with clear audience appeal comprehensively meeting requirements.

task3.Pass: Basic use of tools and techniques building a functional website that meets key requirements (some may be missed); straightforward testing; some refinements made.
task3.Merit: Good use of tools and techniques meeting most requirements; appropriate accessibility features; appropriate functionality and usability testing with appropriate refinements.
task3.Distinction: Creative use of tools and techniques meeting all requirements; effective understanding of web standards; consistent and accessible website; effective functionality and usability testing; considered refinements from a thorough self-review.
